name: Gulab Jamun
description: Sweet, soft dumplings soaked in rose-flavored syrup.
instructions: Mix khoya, flour, and baking soda into a dough.
Shape into small balls.
Fry balls in hot oil until golden brown.
Prepare syrup with sugar, water, and rose water; soak fried balls in syrup.

name: Rasmalai
description: Spongy cottage cheese balls in thickened milk with saffron.
instructions: Curdle milk with vinegar, drain to make paneer.
Knead paneer with flour, shape into balls, and flatten.
Boil in sugar syrup, then soak in sweetened milk with saffron and cardamom.

name: Sheer Khurma
description: A rich vermicelli pudding made during Eid celebrations.
instructions: Fry vermicelli in ghee until golden.
Add milk and sugar, cook until thickened.
Stir in chopped dates and almonds, serve warm or chilled.

name: Kheer
description: A creamy rice pudding flavored with cardamom and nuts.
instructions: Cook rice in milk until soft.
Add sugar and cardamom, stir until thickened.
Garnish with almonds and raisins, serve warm.

name: Jalebi
description: Crispy, spiral-shaped sweets soaked in saffron syrup.
instructions: Mix flour and yeast with water, ferment for 1 hour.
Pipe batter into hot oil in spirals, fry until golden.
Soak in sugar syrup with saffron.

name: Halwa Puri
description: Semolina halwa paired with deep-fried bread.
instructions: Roast semolina in ghee, add sugar and water to make halwa.
Knead flour into dough, roll into puris, and fry.
Serve halwa with puris.

name: Falooda
description: A refreshing dessert with vermicelli, milk, and basil seeds.
instructions: Cook vermicelli, cool it.
Soak basil seeds in water.
Layer milk, vermicelli, seeds, and syrup, top with ice cream.

name: Phirni
description: A creamy rice flour pudding with nuts.
instructions: Mix rice flour with cold milk, cook with rest of milk.
Add sugar and cardamom, stir until thick.
Garnish with pistachios, chill before serving.

name: Barfi
description: A dense milk-based sweet with cardamom.
instructions: Cook khoya and sugar in ghee until thick.
Add cardamom, spread in a tray to set.
Cut into squares, garnish with almonds.

name: Sohan Halwa
description: A rich, nutty halwa from Punjab.
instructions: Mix cornflour with water, cook with sugar and ghee.
Stir until thick, add nuts and cardamom.
Spread and let cool, then cut into pieces.
